title: Missing My Mummy
start: Speak to Leela in Draynor Village.

items.t: 20 fire runes (cannot be substituted by a staff that provides fire runes)

recommended.t: The explorer's ring 3 and above to teleport to Draynor, access to the Draynor lodestone, War's Retreat Teleport, or a charged amulet of glory
Access to fairy rings to reach Uzer Mastaba (code DLQ)
A charged ring of duelling, broomstick, or access to the Al Kharid lodestone
Desert robes, an enchanted water tiara or waterskins
Some food and prayer potions (have your prayer points full before entering the pyramid the second time)

rewards.t: Access to the Amascut statue in Senliten's tomb, giving extra prayer points at the cost of some life points.

steps.t: Talk to Leela, north of the Draynor Village jail. [Chat: accept]

sub.t: If Leela does not show up in Draynor Village, you need to complete the Stolen Hearts and Diamond in the Rough quests first, even if Icthlarin's Little Helper is already completed.

steps.t: Enter the flat-topped pyramid Uzer Mastaba from the west side, south of Uzer.

sub.t: Teleport to the fairy ring DLQ and then run east.
Teleport to Al Kharid and go south to Shantay's Pass (Or use amulet of glory's teleport to Al Kharid).
Use the magic carpet network to get to Uzer.
Teleport with the traveller's necklace to desert eagles' eyrie.

steps.t: In the initial east chamber, rummage and kill the skeleton for a canopic jar.
Head north-west and through the imposing doors to the south.
Kill the four skeletons in the room for a mummy hand and the scroll of the dead. The mummy hand and scroll of the dead don't appear in area loot, you need to right click to take them.
Return to Leela in Draynor Village. [Chat: 5 I think I can deal with this myself.]
The scroll of praise:

sub.t: Get an Al Kharid flyer from Waseem the Leaflet Dropper north of the Al Kharid mine (at the entrance to the desert).
Varrock Lodestone or Archeology Journal Teleport.

With your Al Kharid flyer, talk to Reldo in the Varrock palace library (most northern room of the ground floor) about the pyramid. [Chat: 3 I'd like to talk about a pyramid.] or [Chat: 4 I'd like to talk about a pyramid.] He will give you a scroll of praise.

steps.t: The copied name papyrus and mummy's name papyrus:

sub.t: Play the Sorceress's Garden minigame and obtain a mug of any sq'irkjuice.

You need to use the sq'irkjuice on Ali Morrisane at his stall. Then talk with him. [Chat: 3 I have some questions about a tomb. › 1 I'm after ways to reunite the mummy in the pyramid. › 4 I can't think of anything sensible to ask.].

Talk to him again with a ring of charos (a) equipped. [Chat: 3 I have some questions about a tomb. › 1 I'm after ways to reunite the mummy in the pyramid. › 4 I can't think of anything sensible to ask.].
This step will only work after talking to the Wise Old Man during the Garden of Tranquillity, as the ring does not allow you to persuade people before this step.
You should have received both a copied name papyrus and a mummy's name papyrus.
Do not destroy the copied name papyrus or you will have to re-obtain a sq'irkjuice for another copy.

steps.sec: Preparing the sarcophagus – Collecting canopic jars
steps.t: Return to the pyramid with prayer points.

steps.sec: Preparing the sarcophagus – Collecting canopic jars
steps.t: Again, open the imposing door in the north-west corner.

steps.sec: Preparing the sarcophagus – Collecting canopic jars
steps.t: Kill the golem and descend the stairs (You may be placed in the mummy's tomb after descending the stairs, past the puzzle. If so, you will need to cross the puzzle to do the next 4 steps).

steps.sec: Preparing the sarcophagus – Collecting canopic jars
steps.t: Find a path of blue and green blocks or of red and yellow blocks all the way through.

steps.sec: Preparing the sarcophagus – Collecting canopic jars
steps.t: Go across the tiled room and collect the first canopic jar to the west of the northern staircase.

sub.t: If you spawn at the bottom of the northern staircase simply pick up the canopic jar to the west.

steps.sec: Preparing the sarcophagus – Collecting canopic jars
steps.t: Collect the two remaining canopic jars and mummy with no hand in the tunnels. If you did not collect the fourth earlier, it can be found on one of the skeleton bodies upstairs. "Rummage" them and defeat them.

steps.sec: Preparing the sarcophagus – Collecting canopic jars
steps.t: Use the mummy hand on the mummy with no hand.

steps.sec: Preparing the sarcophagus – Collecting canopic jars
steps.t: Return to the tiled room and cross back towards the empty sarcophagus.

sub.t: You may go upstairs and back downstairs to teleport to the tomb room to skip the tile puzzle.

steps.t: Place jar on the shelves 4 times.
Fill the empty sarcophagus.
Pray at the 5 broken statues.
Repair the chair and table.
Use spice on your jug of wine.
Use wheat on your empty pot.
Replace the pot and jug.
Run east and kill the shadow. Then light the enchanted sconces in the following order: south, north, west, east. Shadows will spawn and must be killed between each sconce lighting.
Return to the Queen's chamber and create the statue on the empty base, then carve it 2 times.

Talk to the Pharaoh Queen who has appeared in front of the table to give her the 2 papyri and the Scroll of Praise. [Chat: 5 I have nothing more to say.] (Not required for quest completion, only for 100% rebuild)
p: The look of the Tomb, after completing the tasks
You can check your progress using the pyramid journal or scroll of the dead.

steps.t: Right-click check-progress on your scroll of the dead or pyramid journal to verify you've rebuilt the mummy 75%. Otherwise, check any parts missed. (Or 100% if you want to finish the mummy)
p: A player restoring the statue of Apmeken

steps.t: Talk to Leela in Draynor Village.
Quest complete!

get_inside.text: Teleport using an amulet of glory to the Draynor Market.
Home Teleport to Draynor lodestone just north of the village (near the portal to Death's office).
Use War's Retreat Teleport and immediately exit via the ground portal to the north of the village.
Use an explorer's ring 3 to teleport to the Falador cabbage patch and then run south then east through the stone wall and then south will teleport to the Draynor Market.
The master archaeologist's outfit hat's teleport function (collectors menu) to the Wise Old Man.
